retirement_reason: The required original embedded.jsonl build cache was deleted with its Git worktree and no byte-for-byte backup was found.
recovery_result: The surviving Qdrant collection matches the historical live-index fingerprint, but reconstructing embedded.jsonl from its stored vectors produced different serialized bytes and was rejected.
immutability_rule: Preserve the fresh-v6 approval and wrapper byte-for-byte. Never repurpose, reinterpret, reset, or use its authorization for fresh-v7 or any other attempt.
reactivation_rule: Fresh-v6 remains retired unless the exact missing file is independently recovered and validates to the recorded size and SHA-256. Reactivation would require a new explicit review and authorization decision; this record itself grants none.
